# Kitsunox triage queue

Generated 2026-10-26T20:38 -- 390 changes scanned across 40 repositories -- **4 to review** -- 0 briefed ($0.0000).

**How to review.** Work down the table. For each alert, read the evidence, run the checklist, then record a disposition (`benign`, `suspicious`, `malicious` or `unclear`) and the minutes spent against its key in `dispositions.csv` next to this file. `kitsunox tally` turns those into the result.

**Trust.** Headings, tables, rule text and checklists are generated by Kitsunox. Everything in an indented block -- commit messages, code evidence, the model's brief -- is written or steerable by the change's author. Read the change itself before deciding.

### Evidence -- why it escalated

- **tag.on_no_branch** (high) -- Tag v0 points at a commit that is on no branch at all -- not the default branch, not a release branch. What consumers run was never merged anywhere a reviewer would look.
  Precedent: reviewdog/action-setup, 2025.

    v0 -> dae6cfe8cc

### Context -- ranks the alert, cannot escalate it

- **context.ci_touched** (medium) in `.github/workflows/publish.yml` -- A CI workflow definition was modified — CI runs with repository secrets, so tampering here is equivalent to code execution with credentials.

- **context.new_contributor** (info) -- The author's first commit to this repo was 18 day(s) before this change. Ordinary for a reviewed pull request — 56% of the control sample — so this carries no weight by itself.

### Checklist

- [ ] Compare the tagged commit with its parent -- this is what consumers of the tag run that no branch contains: <https://github.com/apisec-inc/AI-Surface/compare/bbd7348b3bae2f34aff265e5e1f14cb9f8537262...dae6cfe8cc108153e0f3c0d9b60398f9f9d6e5a3>

- [ ] Check that the commit message describes what the change actually does.

### Commit message (untrusted)

    prep for public release: install from source, PyPI deferred to v1.0

    docs/CI_INTEGRATION.md, and the four example CI files to use
    git+https://github.com/apisec-inc/AI-Surface@v0.5.3 in place of
